provenance.artifactValidation: All 106 assigned IDs are present exactly once; all duplicate canonicals resolve; all cited evidence and source files exist.
provenance.limitation: The jar contains ColorOptions despite older build metadata (recovered verifier listing); do not assume it is exactly the parent commit or an exact HEAD build. Current source was reviewed at requested HEAD; close, AttrTable and ShellLayout are unchanged between HEAD parent and HEAD. No rebuild was performed.
provenance.reusedEvidence: Only the archived screenshots named in reviewedArchivedImages were independently viewed; source-only and unverified dispositions are explicitly distinguished. Recovered verifier commands were read as evidence, never replayed against their sessions.
provenance.display: Private KWin/Xwayland; dark theme; UI scale 1.6; fresh startup 1280x1600 on a 2560x1600 display; later main window 2560x1066, as measured by win captures.
provenance.imageInspection: view_image failed with mountinfo sandbox error. Screenshots were read by scoped escalated base64 commands and emitted as images, per user-approved fallback.
provenance.sandbox: exec_command default sandbox failed with mountinfo path is not absolute; scoped require_escalated reads and private UI actions succeeded. Two first launches ended with tool lifetime; a kept-open PTY stabilized the final session.

isolation.verified: jcmd VM.system_properties; own PIDs and QA_ENVFILE/QA_PIDFILE checked before stopping.
isolation.realFilesUsed: No real circuit files opened; all live tests used new scratch projects. No real preferences or autosaves intentionally read/changed.

provenance.cleanup: qa.sh stop cx-editing after PID checks; app 551969, wrapper 551909 and session 551947 absent on final ps; PTY 78224 exited. No other session stopped.
provenance.repository: No production files changed, no build/tests run, no commit/push. AGENTS.md was untracked at entry. docs/qa appeared concurrently from other work and was left untouched.

severityRubric: P0 observed unsaved-project data loss; P1 normal workflow/cancellation or safe scrolling blocked; P2 usability/correctness with recovery/workaround; P3 polish. Unverified candidates have no accepted severity.
countCaveat: 106 candidate dispositions are not 106 independent bugs. Duplicate IDs reference a canonical candidate; work packages can contain multiple related root causes. Status counts are evidence bookkeeping only.
tested: Independent unsaved scratch File Close > Escape: edit discarded.
Independent unsaved scratch File Close > Save > Save chooser Cancel: edit discarded.
Multi-row Cancel after differing No/Yes values: changes to No/No; Undo restores Yes.
Multi-row commit and three successive Undos: Yes/Yes -> Yes/No -> Yes/No -> No/No.
Typed label followed by canvas click/reselect: draft lost.
Side/inspector drag: requested sizes not retained.
Unfocused Facing wheel: East -> North without clicking editor.
Last editor tab close: canvas remains with gate and no tab.
Fresh isolated shell visual inspection, menu/chooser metric comparison.
Targeted archived screenshot inspection and HEAD source review; no acceptance claim for fixes.

workflows: Light theme and other UI scale factors
Actual data persistence after save/reload; autosave recovery

dispositions.title: Escape (or the dialog's x) on 'Confirm Close' discards unsaved work and closes the project
dispositions.reason: Independent scratch reproduction: unsaved AND gate disappeared after File Close > Escape. File Close > Save > cancel Save also disposed it. Both branches are unchanged at HEAD. Dialog-X and filesystem write failure were not separately exercised. The missing question mark is absent from the hard-coded source string, not proof of clipping.

dispositions.title: FlatLaf metrics stay at 1x while fonts are forced to 1.6x: tiny accelerators, arrows, check marks, checkboxes, window buttons; clipped rows
dispositions.reason: Live Edit popup and Save dialog visibly mix large labels with small accelerators/icons; archived drawer also shows small captions. HEAD retains post-construction font scaling. Do not infer that every reported widget was retested, or prescribe a particular FlatLaf API without validating double scaling.

dispositions.title: None of the three splitters (side panel, inspector, drawer) can be dragged
dispositions.reason: Side and inspector divider drags failed to retain the requested hundreds-of-pixels change; inspector shifted only about five pixels. doLayout reapplies stored size during drag. Drawer was not dragged live; it uses the same SizedSplit path.

dispositions.title: Once closed, the Properties panel can only come back through Preferences > Window > 'Reset window layout to Logisim's defaults'
dispositions.reason: The normal Show Properties path only changes the attribute model; inspector visibility true is restored by reset/initial preference restoration, not that command. No live hide/reset cycle was needed after source tracing. Missing direct restore blocks the normal inspector workflow until layout reset.

dispositions.title: Panel widths and heights are fixed in unscaled pixels, so every panel is too narrow at 1.6x and truncates its content
dispositions.reason: Live inspector truncates names and font values at 1.6 scale; LayoutPrefs retains device-pixel defaults. Fresh Circuits width was wider and its heading readable, so not every panel is always truncated. Separate this sizing defect from the divider interaction defect.

dispositions.title: Properties inspector table is a raw legacy JTable: neon-green 'Supported' cell, no padding, a blank box when empty, raw coordinates in the header
dispositions.reason: Compound inspector styling claim: FPGA fill overlaps inspector-03; padding overlaps inspector-13 and empty state inspector-10. No separate shell defect.

dispositions.title: Editor tab overflow hides the active tab, with no scroll arrows or overflow list
dispositions.reason: Reviewed the original overflow strip: clipped tabs without usable overflow controls. HEAD sets scroll-button policy but not SCROLL_TAB_LAYOUT. Original active-ALU context is inherited from the report; no new 14-tab live reproduction.

dispositions.title: Closing the last tab leaves the circuit on screen with no tab; the circuit list selection goes stale
dispositions.reason: Closing the sole tab live removed its strip while leaving the gate editable and project title intact. Circuit-list staleness after Close Others was not independently reproduced.

dispositions.title: The welcome screen covers a project that is already open; 'New project' opens a second window; the project's own circuit can't be reached
dispositions.reason: Fresh startup visibly overlays an existing Untitled circuit with Welcome. New callback calls doNew while recent-file callback uses doOpenReplacingBlank. Second-window and circuit-click recovery details are source/reported evidence, not a clean independent live comparison.

dispositions.title: A new project starts with an invisible 'Load Library' undo step
dispositions.reason: Startup loads default libraries through proj.doAction, explaining a startup undo entry. No separate pristine Undo-history screenshot captured.

dispositions.title: Simulation controls float in the middle of the toolbar and jump when tools change or the toolbar is hidden
dispositions.reason: Live full-window screenshots show simulation controls starting well before the right edge with large unused toolbar space. Hide-toolbar jump not retested; alignment is usability polish.

dispositions.title: Toolbar mixes 2005 pixel-art tool icons with thin line icons; simulation buttons have no hover and aren't focusable
dispositions.reason: Mixed legacy and line icon styles are visible. Replacement is a design decision; missing hover/focus behavior was not independently tested.

dispositions.title: Tooltip and terminology inconsistencies between the toolbar, the menus and the tooltips themselves
dispositions.reason: Unify command names, distinguish pin presets, and rename Auto to Fit to contents. Other tooltip/shortcut claims remain reported rather than independently inspected.

dispositions.title: Menus keep 2005-era wording, duplicates and inconsistent capitalisation
dispositions.reason: Live Edit popup confirms disabled appearance commands and verbose Undo wording. These are discoverability/copy choices, not blocked workflows. Other menu subclaims were not retoured.

dispositions.title: Window > 'Show Navigation Pane' is out of sync with the activity bar; there are no toggles for the inspector, drawer or status bar
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Bottom drawer: each tab's x hides the whole drawer, there is no drawer toggle, and the content is legacy (tabs inside tabs, titled borders)
dispositions.reason: BottomPanel close callback hides the entire drawer rather than removing its tab; archived nested controls are visible. The absolute claim that timing cannot reopen is too strong: the same Simulate command is an existing entry point.

dispositions.title: STATE section expands to nothing (or a bare 'Name | Value' JTable header) with no empty state
dispositions.reason: Same register-state empty-state claim, not another defect.

dispositions.title: Status bar is almost empty: coordinates and messages are never set, simulation and tick-rate info never appears, and the zoom duplicates the pill
dispositions.reason: No callers of setCoordinates/setMessage were found; live bar stays sparse. Reject the blanket implication that simulation/tick information is never wired: Frame has explicit setTickRate/setSimulationState paths.

dispositions.title: Dark chrome layering: activity and status bars are pure #000; panels are lighter than the editor; five unrelated greys
dispositions.reason: Black activity/status strips are visible, but the preferred tonal hierarchy is subjective. Group theme polish; do not score darker chrome as a functional failure.

dispositions.title: Title bar shows the build hash, a shouted '[UNSAVED]', an invisible floppy emoji and the old 'main of Untitled' wording
dispositions.reason: Long development-build title and UNSAVED indicator are visible. Hiding debug metadata outside About is polish; a dev build ID is not intrinsically erroneous.

dispositions.title: Circuits panel header is truncated to 'CI…' with its title misaligned against the action buttons
dispositions.reason: Header crowding is part of scale/minimum-width policy. Fresh 1.6 session displayed CIRCUITS fully, so the original truncation is configuration-dependent.

dispositions.title: Activity bar: Search and Settings open modal dialogs instead of views; no hover state; no shortcut hints
dispositions.reason: Bottom action icons may legitimately open dialogs while top icons switch views. Standardize affordances if desired; the behavior alone is not a bug. Hover/tooltip details not retested.

dispositions.title: Find Action palette: small fixed window, a stray horizontal scrollbar, debug footer text, low-contrast selected row, garish orange match chips
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Simulate side view duplicates the toolbar controls and uses a raw JTree with unscaled overlapping icons
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Library 'tree' toggle uses a folder icon and opens a 2005-style JTree with overlapping icons and clipped names
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Startup 'Autosave found' prompts: raw file names, unclear choices, hidden behind the splash, triggered by pristine blank projects
dispositions.reason: Unnamed autosaves target user.home; QA isolation failure amplifies recovered prompts. Per-file recovery/splash-overlap behavior was not independently replayed. Keep application recovery UX distinct from the harness defect.

dispositions.title: Splash and About screens are the unchanged 2005 artwork; About credits are unreadable on the dark theme
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Help > User's Guide opens JavaHelp with Windows-XP-era screenshots and a legacy viewer
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: File > Open uses the stock Swing JFileChooser at 1x size: 3 visible rows, horizontal list, no places
dispositions.reason: Live Save chooser confirms compact legacy controls, but native places/sidebar/preview are feature requests. Open chooser's claimed row count was not independently tested.

dispositions.title: First launch opens a half-width, full-height, non-maximised window at 0,0 on the Circuits view
dispositions.reason: Fresh isolated preferences produced a 1280x1600 window on a 2560x1600 private display at origin. This is a poor default layout preference, not a workflow blocker.

dispositions.title: ConcurrentModificationException in hotkeySync on the preferences thread
dispositions.reason: Recovered log contains ConcurrentModificationException in hotkeySync on java.util.prefs dispatcher. HEAD retains an unfiltered preference listener and iteration of mutable gui_sync_objects off EDT. No independent race reproduction; frequency and user impact remain unknown.

dispositions.title: Preferences (seen along the way): content floats mid-page, tiny checkboxes, stray horizontal scrollbar, 'Zoom factor' means UI scale
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Canvas at '100%' ignores the 1.6 interface scale: circuits render tiny, black labels vanish, white REG boxes and a neon ALU
dispositions.reason: Compound canvas claim repeats annotation contrast (canvas-02) and default zoom/readability (canvas-01). Custom appearance colors in loaded files are not automatically theme bugs.

dispositions.title: Welcome screen disappears (blank editor) while the Preferences window is open
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Auto-Tick (Ctrl+K) on a circuit without a clock opens a fixed 300x400 dialog with an empty list
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Tooltips near the right screen edge are cut off
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Editor tabs and zoom pill: tiny low-contrast close x, dirty dot in the wrong place, no hover in the pill, 10% zoom steps
dispositions.reason: Dirty dot placement and 10-percent zoom steps are choices. Live tabs/pill exist and source confirms unfocusable, unfilled pill buttons; missing hover and empty-canvas scrollbar behavior were not retested. Group small-target and zoom usability work.

dispositions.title: Side-panel list and filter polish: placeholder touches its icon, redundant 'main (main)', weak selected-row contrast
dispositions.reason: Fresh screenshot shows close icon/placeholder spacing and main (main) redundancy. Treat this as list/filter copy and spacing polish; reported selected-row contrast ratio not independently measured.

dispositions.title: Inspector is 280 unscaled px wide with a fixed 50/50 column split, so about half of all labels and values are cut off at 1.6x
dispositions.reason: Same device-pixel width and clipped two-column inspector, visually confirmed live.

dispositions.title: The Properties panel cannot be resized: dragging the divider snaps back, and the divider is a 5 px unscaled target
dispositions.reason: Same SizedSplit drag snapback, independently reproduced on the inspector.

dispositions.title: Neon full-cell colour blocks: pure #00FF00 / #FF0000 FPGA row, orange 'Required f...', and every colour attribute painted as a saturated cell
dispositions.reason: Live full-cell green support status dominates the panel. HdlColorRenderer source confirms saturated status/required/color fills. Other color-attribute stacks were not independently viewed.

dispositions.title: The 'FPGA supported' row is pinned first for everything, including wires, text labels, drawing shapes and mixed selections, where it is meaningless or wrong
dispositions.reason: HDL row queries compInst; mixed-selection title setup chooses one encountered component factory. It does not aggregate support across selected factories. Always-show styling is design; misleading aggregate status is the correctness concern.

dispositions.title: The mouse wheel never scrolls the property list; over the value column it silently changes values (scroll-jacking)
dispositions.reason: Without clicking the value editor, two wheel-up notches over Facing changed East to North and rotated the gate. Table consumes wheel handling at the component level; long splitter-list scrolling was source-assessed, not live-reproduced.

dispositions.title: Wheel gestures behave inconsistently: dropdown rows record one undo step per notch, and wheel direction is inverted between row types
dispositions.reason: Option-combo branch immediately applies each notch, numeric branch uses pending settle timer. Throttle ignores close events. Exact lost-notch count and pen-width direction were not independently replayed.

dispositions.title: A half-typed value is silently discarded when the user clicks the canvas
dispositions.reason: Typed ScratchLabel was visible in the editor; clicking empty canvas then reselecting the gate left Label empty. The uncommitted draft is cancelled when the model changes before focusLost commits. No saved project content was lost.

dispositions.title: Validation happens after the fact in modal dialogs; invalid input is thrown away and messages are inconsistent
dispositions.reason: AttributeSetTableModel exposes NumberFormatException messages; AttrTable shows modal warnings. Broad claim that every invalid field discards drafts or has the same icon was not live verified.

dispositions.title: Error and validation copy is old-Logisim wording: shouting, duplicated 'Error:', missing spaces, invisible characters
dispositions.reason: The recovered validation wording merits plain-language revision, but individual error dialogs were not independently opened. Bundle with validation UX, not a separate functional bug.

dispositions.title: On a fresh window, clicking components shows a completely blank Properties panel (Poke tool is the default), with no empty state; files without a toolbar have no visible Select tool at all
dispositions.reason: Fresh window has active Poke tool and a blank bordered Properties panel without guidance. Missing Select tool in files with custom/empty toolbars was not independently tested.

dispositions.title: Closing the Properties panel is a one-way trip: no menu item or shortcut brings it back, 'Show Properties' does nothing, and the hidden state persists across restarts
dispositions.reason: Same missing direct Properties-panel restore path.

dispositions.title: The inspector is still the 2005 raw two-column JTable: no groups, no search, no descriptions, no editor affordances, booleans as Yes/No dropdowns
dispositions.reason: Live table lacks persistent editor affordances and grouping. Sections, search and property help are improvements; a two-column table itself is not a bug.

dispositions.title: Cells have no padding: text is flush to the cell edges and labels run into values ('Output Value0/1', 'Circuit Namemain')
dispositions.reason: Output Value0/1 and neighboring labels/values visibly run together. HdlColorRenderer removes cell borders/insets; fix padding separately from total panel width.

dispositions.title: Heavy selection and focus styling: saturated full-width blue row bars and a blue rectangle around the whole table
dispositions.reason: Strong blue row/focus styling is visible during multi-edit, but heaviness is aesthetic. Retain visible keyboard focus while improving contrast and restraint.

dispositions.title: Panel title uppercases everything (misrepresenting case-sensitive names), shows raw coordinates, truncates, and says 'VARIOUS ITEMS × 3'
dispositions.reason: PanelHeader uppercases user content as well as labels, so identifier casing is misrepresented. Coordinates and Various items wording are lower-priority design choices.

dispositions.title: In the Appearance editor the panel header is stale: it keeps the last layout selection ('LED (1170,970)') while showing circuit or shape attributes
dispositions.reason: Archived crop shows LED (1170,970) header over circuit attributes. HEAD appearance path sets AttrTable through its manager, bypassing the Frame method that updates Inspector title. No live appearance retest.

dispositions.title: Any selection that includes a wire loses every shared property: rubber-band selecting pins + gates shows only the FPGA row
dispositions.reason: Source confirms intersection includes wire attributes. This is mathematically correct for all selected objects, but component-only aggregate editing may be more useful. Define scope explicitly before excluding wires; do not silently pretend a change applied to everything.

dispositions.title: Multi-select editing: '(various)' looks like a real value, the editor pre-fills the first item's value, and labels are silently auto-numbered
dispositions.reason: Mixed values are displayed as a plain string and multi-label edits use AutoLabel. Correct the claimed cause: SelectionAttributes stores null on disagreement, not the first component's value; editor defaults can still turn opening/committing a mixed field into a concrete value. No independent multi-component live test.

dispositions.title: Editing several table rows at once creates three undo entries, including an empty one
dispositions.reason: Two-row Yes commit required three Undos to restore No/No; observed sequence Yes/Yes -> Yes/No -> Yes/No -> No/No (the original report's no-op position differs). More seriously, Escape cancelling a No/Yes multi-edit changed it to No/No. One Undo restored the changed Yes. Same cancel-handler writes explain both symptoms.

dispositions.title: Undo history is useless for property edits: every entry reads 'Change Selection Property'
dispositions.reason: Property actions share one generic label in source and the live menu. Improve names with attribute/selection scope; this is undo discoverability, not undo failure.

dispositions.title: Tooltips for cut-off values are themselves cut off at the screen edge (and so is the close-button tooltip)
dispositions.reason: Same right-edge tooltip clipping claim. Canonical remains unverified because heavyweight popup bounds and harness composition were not isolated.

dispositions.title: Font picker is an unlabelled legacy dialog titled 'Select Value' with unscaled checkboxes and a clipped preview
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Colour picker is a bulky modal colour-wheel dialog with no swatches, unlabelled tiny radio buttons and redundant controls
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Property naming is inconsistent: Title Case vs sentence case, trailing colons, Java font names, instruction text as a value
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Keyboard editing barely works: no type-to-edit, F2 dead after clicking a label, no visible focused cell
dispositions.reason: CellEditor rejects typed KeyEvents except Space, confirming no normal type-to-edit. F2 on the noneditable label column is not itself proof of failure. Add a clear focus/edit path and retest keyboard-only workflow.

dispositions.title: Tool defaults and a selected component look identical; nothing says you are editing defaults for new parts
dispositions.reason: Tool-default versus instance editing needs an explicit scope label. Source has a separate ToolAttributeAction route; no independent comparative screenshot of tool defaults.

dispositions.title: The STATE section expands into an empty strip with no explanation
dispositions.reason: Register list filters on ATTR_SHOW_IN_TAB and reconstructs a header even when there are no rows. Missing explanatory empty state is supported; an actual opted-in register failing to appear was not established.

dispositions.title: Default colours shown and edited in the inspector are invisible on the dark canvas (#000000 text/pen, #0000FF LED label)
dispositions.reason: Annotation black-on-dark is confirmed under canvas-02. LED-label and appearance-pen variants were not independently checked; do not expand the confirmed scope to all saved custom colors.

dispositions.title: Editor types behave inconsistently on click: some dropdowns open immediately, the editable Data Bits combo does not, numbers are bare text
dispositions.reason: Editable numeric combo and finite-choice combo legitimately differ. Persistent affordances/range hints would help; different editor types alone are not a functional bug.

dispositions.title: Labels must be HDL identifiers even for users who never target an FPGA ('my gate', 'Clock A', circuit 'main 2' rejected)
dispositions.reason: Separating display labels from HDL identifiers is a product/data-format decision. The report does not establish accidental regression; retain as a design proposal with export/name compatibility tests.

dispositions.title: Other things noticed along the way: autosave dialog copy, Project Options scaling, splitter fan-out, appearance-view chrome, toolbar icon
dispositions.reason: Mixed catch-all: autosave repeats shell-26, icon style shell-12, options scaling shell-02. Splitter fan-out preserving existing mappings is not demonstrated faulty; appearance tab naming and options subclaims remain unverified.

dispositions.title: Canvas '100%' ignores the 1.6 UI scale – circuits, values and labels render at 1/1.6 size and files open tiny
dispositions.reason: Live 100-percent gate size is small relative to 1.6-scale chrome. Canvas zoom and interface scale are separate concepts; automatically multiplying serialized circuit coordinates is not an established fix. Calibrate initial viewport/readability as a design change.

dispositions.title: Text-tool annotations are drawn black on the dark canvas (effectively invisible)
dispositions.reason: Reviewed archived committed text: black on dark canvas is difficult to read. HEAD TextTool stamps a black default and does not register it as a themed color. Preserve explicit file colors when designing a theme-aware default/migration.

dispositions.title: Inline canvas text editor is the legacy yellow sticky note (#FFFF99, black text) in dark mode, and leaves a stale halo
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Pin values: pure-blue radix letter and white-on-bright-green bit ovals are unreadable
dispositions.reason: Archived pin crop shows dark-blue radix letter and pale digit on bright green. HEAD hard-codes Color.BLUE and Color.WHITE. Exact contrast ratio not recomputed; legibility problem is visually clear.

dispositions.title: Bus wires are the same colour as component outlines in dark theme
dispositions.reason: Light bus and component outlines are visible in the archived fit image. Similar hue alone is not a bug; width and junction geometry also encode meaning. Consider an additional distinction after testing schematic clarity.

dispositions.title: Double-click opens a modal 'Edit/specify a components label' dialog, even on subcircuits, with a looping error dialog
dispositions.reason: Double-click navigation versus label editing is a convention choice. The modal-label workflow was not independently replayed; propose a deliberate shortcut policy, retaining access to label editing.

dispositions.title: Rotating a component pivots about its anchor and disconnects every wire
dispositions.reason: Source confirms Facing-only rotation without rerouting. Reconnection is a feature decision with risk of unintended net changes; do not automatically rotate about center or reconnect nearest wires without a defined electrical-connectivity policy.

dispositions.title: Keyboard model is legacy: arrows re-face, no nudge, Escape doesn't deselect, no Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+0 / Ctrl+=
dispositions.reason: Arrow-key facing and alternative redo/zoom shortcuts are compatibility/discoverability choices. Add discoverable commands and optional aliases; do not call every departure from another editor a broken workflow.

dispositions.title: Context menus are nearly empty, missing on empty canvas, and Ctrl+click opens a menu instead of toggling selection
dispositions.reason: Richer context menus and Ctrl-click additive selection are proposals. Saved mouse mappings must be respected; a configured context-menu gesture is not intrinsically defective.

dispositions.title: Grid rendering is inconsistent across zoom: two-level only at exactly 100%, square blobs when zoomed in, grey moiré wash when zoomed out
dispositions.reason: Reviewed archived grid comparison: hierarchy changes and low-zoom dense mesh are visible. Source has two-level rendering only at f==1.0 and no general screen-density threshold.

dispositions.title: Zoom steps are linear 5/10/20 %: ~55 wheel notches from 100% to 1000%, and 5% minimum is useless
dispositions.reason: Additive zoom steps exist in the source; choosing multiplicative steps is usability work. The precise reported wheel count was not rerun.

dispositions.title: Zoom-to-fit hugs the top-left edge, keeps a huge scroll range, and is labelled just 'Auto'
dispositions.reason: Archived fit result has substantial unused right space and content near the left edge. Reject the alleged missing-centering call: ZoomControl calls setZoomFactorCenter, CanvasPane handles CENTER, and Canvas.center calculates offsets. Near-origin negative-scroll clamping and unchanged-factor skipping are candidates, not proven causes.

dispositions.title: Selection feedback: wires show only endpoint dots; handles pile up, scale with zoom and hide small parts
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Rubber-band live preview highlights wires and pins but not gates
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Port hover ring leaves stale blue pixels after the mouse moves away
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Splitter is an illegible 20 px blob with 7-unit bit labels printed over its own stubs
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Width-mismatch badges use light-theme colours (dark red on peach) and overlap other labels
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Placement ghost of gates looks exactly like a placed gate
dispositions.reason: Gate paintGhost calls paintBase, whose color assignment overrides the requested ghost color. Archived ghost outline is the same bright family as a placed gate, but the provided placed crop is selected, so pixel-identical complete rendering is not established.

dispositions.title: Components are unfilled wireframes – grid dots show through gate, pin and tunnel bodies
dispositions.reason: Transparent schematic symbols are a valid established design. Body fill is optional polish; do not count wireframe styling or visible grid inside gates as a defect.

dispositions.title: Input and output pins look the same; unconnected output shows 'U'; pin labels cramped and bottom-aligned
dispositions.reason: Input/output differentiation and label spacing merit design review. U denotes undefined state, not an error in itself. No independent full pin-variant comparison.

dispositions.title: Port markers are 4 px specks in low-contrast grey/red
dispositions.reason: Larger or zoom-adaptive hit/port affordances may improve use; tiny marker and error-signaling interpretations were not independently measured for every component.

dispositions.title: Ctrl+D duplicates exactly on top of the original (looks like nothing happened)
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: No drag-and-drop from the parts palette to the canvas
dispositions.reason: ComponentTile arms tools on mousePressed and has no drag-transfer handlers. The promised drag/drop interaction is absent in that path; click-then-place remains usable. No live palette drag repeated.

dispositions.title: Palette content jumps ~125 px after the first placement ('Recently used' inserted at top)
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Welcome 'New project' opens a second window and leaves the blank one stuck on the welcome page
dispositions.reason: Same startup Welcome/New project ownership mismatch.

dispositions.title: Legacy wording and irrelevant items in the Edit menu / undo names
dispositions.reason: Same legacy Edit-menu wording and appearance-only command visibility.

dispositions.title: Off-screen indicators look like crop-mark brackets, are unscaled, and collide with content/zoom pill
dispositions.reason: Edge-indicator shape, scale and placement need visual design review. Reported collisions were not independently inspected; no blanket removal recommendation.

dispositions.title: Tunnel label is crammed against the tunnel outline
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: Window title shows debug build ID plus a 💾 emoji plus '[UNSAVED]'
dispositions.reason: Same development title/dirty-indicator polish.

dispositions.title: Canvas toolbar mixes legacy colour bitmaps with line icons; 'Add Register' icon unreadable; both pin tools say 'Add Pin'
dispositions.reason: Same mixed toolbar icon styles. Identical pin tooltips also overlap shell-13 and were not independently hovered.

dispositions.title: Branching from a wire routes horizontal-first, overlapping the existing wire and cutting across others
dispositions.reason: Not independently reproduced, visually inspected, or source-traced in this bounded review. Retained as a candidate, not counted as a verified defect.

dispositions.title: No hover affordances on the canvas: components don't highlight, ports/wires show no tooltip
dispositions.reason: Hover highlight and generic net-value tooltips are useful additions, not proof of an existing functional failure. Absence was not independently timed.

dispositions.title: Autosave recovery prompt is developer-worded, appears once per file, hides behind the splash, and writes dotfiles into $HOME
dispositions.reason: Same recovery/autosave behavior; original parallel sessions shared real user.home and may have contaminated frequency.

dispositions.title: Splash screen is the old graffiti logo with tiny unscaled status text
dispositions.reason: Same splash artwork/style claim; canonical remains unverified in this bounded review.

dispositions.title: Inspector noise seen while editing: neon 'FPGA supported' row, amber 'Required fo…', truncated keys, raw coordinates
dispositions.reason: Same saturated inspector status styling, with truncation already covered by shell-05 and padding by inspector-13.

dispositions.title: Status bar and activity bar are pure #000000, clashing with #1E1F22 chrome and #292A2D panels
dispositions.reason: Same dark chrome tonal preference; no new defect.

dispositions.title: Editor tab shows both a dirty dot and a close × next to the name
dispositions.reason: Same dirty-marker/close-button placement preference; both controls existing is not a functional bug.

newFindings.title: Cancelling a multi-row attribute edit mutates differing values
newFindings.reason: Extension of the same cancellation/undo root cause, not an additional independent bug count.
newFindings.reproduction: AND gate: Negate 1=No, Negate 2=Yes. Select both label rows, open Negate 1 value, Escape to dismiss popup then Escape to cancel editing. For undo test start both No, multi-set Yes, undo three times.
newFindings.fix: Cancellation must only discard the draft. Capture target rows and pre-edit values before editor teardown. Commit compatible targets through one atomic SetAttributeAction; suppress no-op mutations and reentrant commits.
newFindings.acceptance: Cancel with mixed values leaves all values and undo depth unchanged. One Enter commit creates one undo item; one Undo restores all original values and one Redo reapplies them. Cover popup Escape, editor Escape, focus loss, model switch and mixed component selections.

newFindings.title: Preferences isolation does not isolate unnamed autosaves
newFindings.reason: Original harness leaves user.home unchanged. Private Java home was supplied and verified for this review; no real autosave cleanup was attempted.
newFindings.fix: In a scratch harness set user.home=$D/home plus private preference/config roots; validate effective JVM properties. Capture actual display/window geometry, handle heavyweight popups explicitly, keep the launch terminal alive and record jar hash/build provenance. Never clear real autosaves.
newFindings.acceptance: Creating/closing/recovering disposable projects touches only the session tree. Nondefault-size captures include correct bounds. Session stop validates PIDs and leaves every other compositor/app untouched.

fixPlan.title: Make project close cancellation safe
fixPlan.reproduction: New scratch project; place an AND gate; File > Close; Escape. Repeat with Save, then cancel the Save chooser.
fixPlan.observed: Both routes dispose the edited project and leave a blank replacement. Only disposable unsaved in-memory content was lost; recoverability from autosave was not tested.
fixPlan.cause: MenuFile only excludes result 2, so CLOSED_OPTION (-1) proceeds; it also ignores doSave's false result. Frame.confirmClose is safer for dismissal but stops autosave even after a cancelled/failed Save, so blindly routing to it is insufficient.
fixPlan.fix: Use one close-decision routine for menu/window/quit entry points. Proceed only on explicit discard or successful save; keep project, undo history and autosave running on Escape, dialog X, Cancel and failed/cancelled Save. Dispose and clean autosave only after an accepted decision. Localize the prompt.
fixPlan.acceptance: Run scratch tests for Escape, dialog X, Cancel, Save success, Save chooser Cancel, unwritable target, Discard, one-window and multiple-window cases. Cancel/failure preserves the exact component/attribute model, dirty state, frame and running autosave; success closes exactly the intended project.

fixPlan.title: Remove writes from attribute cancellation; batch multi-row commits
fixPlan.reproduction: AND gate: Negate 1=No, Negate 2=Yes. Select both label rows, open Negate 1 value, Escape to dismiss popup then Escape to cancel editing. For undo test start both No, multi-set Yes, undo three times.
fixPlan.observed: Cancel makes both No; one Undo restores the changed Yes. Multi-commit sequence is Yes/Yes -> Yes/No -> Yes/No -> No/No over three Undos.
fixPlan.cause: AttrTable.fireEditingCanceled notifies listeners, then writes the editor value to every selected row. JTable has already cleared editing-row state, defeating the skip. Each setValueAt generates a separate project action.
fixPlan.fix: Cancellation must only discard the draft. Capture target rows and pre-edit values before editor teardown. Commit compatible targets through one atomic SetAttributeAction; suppress no-op mutations and reentrant commits.
fixPlan.acceptance: Cancel with mixed values leaves all values and undo depth unchanged. One Enter commit creates one undo item; one Undo restores all original values and one Redo reapplies them. Cover popup Escape, editor Escape, focus loss, model switch and mixed component selections.

fixPlan.title: Make property scrolling safe
fixPlan.reproduction: Select the gate, leave canvas focus, hover Facing value without clicking and scroll up twice.
fixPlan.observed: East changes to North and the gate rotates. A normal wheel gesture can edit the circuit unexpectedly.
fixPlan.cause: AttrTable installs a wheel listener and applies values under the pointer; non-value paths return without forwarding to the enclosing scrollpane. Combo changes bypass numeric-gesture batching.
fixPlan.fix: Default wheel input scrolls the table. Require an explicitly active editor or documented modifier for value nudging; forward unused events. Use one direction convention and one gesture transaction across editor types.
fixPlan.acceptance: A 64-bit splitter property list scrolls over both columns without changing circuit attributes or undo depth. Explicit numeric/enum nudge has predictable direction and one Undo per gesture; rapid/high-resolution wheel events are handled deterministically.

fixPlan.title: Preserve drafts across selection/focus changes
fixPlan.reproduction: Type ScratchLabel in the selected gate's Label field, click empty canvas, then reselect the gate.
fixPlan.observed: The visible draft disappears and the label remains empty.
fixPlan.cause: setAttrTableModel cancels the editor before focusLost can commit; validation messages separately expose raw conversion text.
fixPlan.fix: Resolve the active editor before changing models. Commit valid drafts once; retain invalid text with an inline error and a defined focus policy. Escape alone discards the draft. Avoid raw Java exception copy.
fixPlan.acceptance: Enter, Tab and valid canvas-focus transfer persist the same value exactly once; Escape does not. Invalid text remains editable and associated with its field; changing selection never applies a draft to the wrong object.

fixPlan.title: Stop restoring divider preferences during user drags
fixPlan.reproduction: Drag inspector left about 300 px and side panel right about 230 px, slowly then release.
fixPlan.observed: Requested sizes do not persist; only a small incidental divider change is possible.
fixPlan.cause: SizedSplit.doLayout repeatedly reapplies storedSize while continuousLayout runs, before mouseReleased stores the result.
fixPlan.fix: Apply stored dimensions on initialization or explicit restore, not every layout. Track active drag if needed; persist the actual final child size. Scale divider hit targets.
fixPlan.acceptance: All three dividers follow the pointer, retain the final size, survive window resize and isolated restart, and keep both panes usable at 1.0/1.6/2.0 UI scale. Drawer drag remains a required acceptance test, not a live test completed here.

fixPlan.title: Use one scale policy and readable panel minimums
fixPlan.reproduction: Open a fresh dark window at UI scale 1.6; inspect gate properties, Edit menu and Save chooser.
fixPlan.observed: Inspector names/values elide; menu shortcuts and chooser icons are much smaller than labels. Original drawer crop shows the same metric mismatch.
fixPlan.cause: Late font-only resizing coexists with device-pixel LayoutPrefs and custom metrics. Do not assume simply multiplying everything by 1.6 is safe.
fixPlan.fix: Define logical UI dimensions, integrate font and Look-and-Feel metrics once, remove double scaling, migrate stored sizes and add content-aware column widths/padding. Use accessible elision disclosure where finite width remains necessary.
fixPlan.acceptance: Rendered 1.0/1.6/2.0 dark/light matrix includes long circuit names, a 64-row splitter, menus, chooser and drawer at narrow/default/maximized widths. Labels and accelerator regions must not overlap; major controls and complete values remain reachable.

fixPlan.title: Give hidden panels a direct restore path
fixPlan.reproduction: Close Properties; invoke a component's Show Properties. For drawer, close one timing tab.
fixPlan.observed: Source shows Show Properties only changes its model, while drawer tab X hides the whole drawer. State list lacks guidance when nothing is opted in.
fixPlan.cause: Visibility state is separate from the actions that target those panels. BottomPanel deliberately maps tab close to drawer hide.
fixPlan.fix: Add synchronized Window menu toggles and make Show Properties reveal Inspector. Separate hide-drawer from close-tab affordances, retaining existing reopen commands. Explain empty STATE and how to enable a register.
fixPlan.acceptance: Hide and reopen every panel without resetting unrelated sizes, before/after restart; menu checks agree with visibility. Closing one tab has the documented scope. Empty and opted-in-register state views both render useful content.

fixPlan.title: Keep active tabs reachable and final-tab state coherent
fixPlan.reproduction: Open enough circuits to overflow the strip (archived evidence), and close the sole tab (independently reproduced).
fixPlan.observed: Archived overflow has no usable scroll controls; live last-tab close leaves the editor active without a tab.
fixPlan.cause: Scroll-button properties do not switch JTabbedPane to scroll layout. Empty EditorTabModel clears only selection; the canvas keeps current circuit.
fixPlan.fix: Use scroll layout with active-tab reveal and overflow picker; avoid rebuilding the entire strip unnecessarily. Define last-tab policy: retain the current tab or show an empty-editor view. Synchronize circuit list and tabs.
fixPlan.acceptance: Open at least 20 long-named layout/appearance/HDL tabs, navigate by mouse and keyboard, close active/other/all tabs, and rename/reorder circuits. The active editor is always identifiable and reachable.

fixPlan.title: Keep inspector identity and aggregate values truthful
fixPlan.reproduction: View a mixed selection; switch from an instance to Appearance; compare a mixed-case circuit/label with the panel title.
fixPlan.observed: Source uses one factory for aggregate HDL support and uppercases identifiers. Archived Appearance screenshot shows a stale LED title over circuit attributes. Mixed-value editor defaults are ambiguous.
fixPlan.cause: Header updates are owned by Frame while another manager swaps AttrTable directly; aggregation/display policy is embedded in generic rendering.
fixPlan.fix: Make model/title/scope updates atomic and preserve user-entered casing. Aggregate HDL capability across applicable objects or show Mixed/Not applicable. Represent mixed values as a typed state and require an explicit change before applying defaults.
fixPlan.acceptance: Titles match actual tool/instance/shape/circuit scope after every switch. Mixed supported/unsupported selections never show uniformly Supported. Opening and cancelling a mixed field changes nothing; bulk label numbering is previewed/documented.

fixPlan.title: Improve property readability and keyboard access
fixPlan.reproduction: Inspect fresh Poke state, an AND gate and keyboard entry into the property table.
fixPlan.observed: Blank Properties has no instruction; saturated status fill dominates; labels run into values. Typed KeyEvents except Space are rejected by the editor.
fixPlan.cause: Generic HdlColorRenderer removes insets and overloads background colors; Null model has no empty state; CellEditor blocks ordinary typed starts.
fixPlan.fix: Use padded cells, small status/color swatches, an explanatory empty state and persistent editable/read-only affordances. Provide visible keyboard focus, type-to-edit and a shortcut to reach Inspector.
fixPlan.acceptance: Keyboard-only user can enter, edit, commit and cancel supported values with visible focus. Long values are accessible. Dark/light views preserve readable contrast without relying on saturated fills.

fixPlan.title: Separate themed defaults from explicit schematic colors
fixPlan.reproduction: Review dark-canvas text annotation and a binary input with value 1; archived images were inspected.
fixPlan.observed: Default annotation is black on dark; radix letter is pure blue and the digit has weak contrast over green.
fixPlan.cause: TextTool stores black as an explicit color; Pin uses literal blue and white independent of theme/fill.
fixPlan.fix: Introduce a semantic automatic text default with a compatible serialization/migration policy, while preserving intentional custom colors. Choose pin text/radix colors from background-aware theme tokens.
fixPlan.acceptance: New and legacy fixtures with automatic and explicit colors remain readable in dark/light modes and after save/load/export. Explicit user colors are not silently rewritten. Validate small binary/hex pins at common zooms.

fixPlan.title: Keep grid density and placement preview stable
fixPlan.reproduction: Compare archived 100-percent, intermediate, large and very small zoom grids; compare gate ghost with placed outline.
fixPlan.observed: Grid hierarchy exists only at exactly 100%; low zoom becomes a dense mesh. Gate ghost overrides the requested preview color.
fixPlan.cause: GridPainter branches on f==1.0 and draws every point; AbstractGate.paintBase replaces the ghost painter's color.
fixPlan.fix: Choose grid detail from screen-pixel spacing, retaining major/minor hierarchy across zooms. Pass explicit normal/ghost/selection paint style to gate painters instead of overriding color.
fixPlan.acceptance: Rendered 5/25/50/100/110/160/200/1000-percent views avoid mesh aliasing and excessive squares. A placement preview is distinguishable from a committed part in both themes without hiding ports.

fixPlan.title: Validate fit near the circuit origin before changing zoom policy
fixPlan.reproduction: Archived MUX4WAY16 Fit image shows a left-hugging circuit and unused right space. No new live fit test.
fixPlan.observed: Asymmetry is visible, but the original 'never centers' source explanation is false.
fixPlan.cause: Center calls exist. Negative scroll offsets near origin and skipping center when zoom changes by less than 0.01 are hypotheses requiring a fixture reproduction.
fixPlan.fix: First reproduce at origin and at translated positive coordinates. If confirmed, add viewport padding/origin translation and center even at unchanged zoom. Rename Auto to Fit to contents. Decide initial zoom and multiplicative steps as separate design choices.
fixPlan.acceptance: Fit keeps all labels within padded viewport and centers near-origin/translated circuits at unchanged and changed factors. Panning, hit testing and serialized coordinates remain correct; empty circuit has a defined harmless result.

fixPlan.title: Make Welcome own a consistent project lifecycle
fixPlan.reproduction: Start without a file using fresh isolated preferences; choose New or a recent file.
fixPlan.observed: Welcome sits over an existing Untitled project; callbacks use different ownership policies. Default library loading is recorded as an action.
fixPlan.cause: Startup constructs a project before Welcome, and New always allocates another frame; bootstrap work uses user-action history.
fixPlan.fix: Either make Welcome a projectless view or reuse its known blank project consistently. Do not place bootstrap library loading on the user undo stack. Circuit selection must enter an editor.
fixPlan.acceptance: Fresh New produces one intended editable project/window; open/recent/new follow the documented policy. The pristine project has no user-visible undo action and does not produce spurious recovery work.

fixPlan.title: Wire the status fields that are actually intended
fixPlan.reproduction: Move around a circuit and inspect status source callers.
fixPlan.observed: Coordinates/messages have no callers; tick/simulation setters do exist.
fixPlan.cause: Partially integrated StatusBar API, not proof all simulator status is broken.
fixPlan.fix: Connect pointer coordinates and actionable editor messages if they are part of the design; otherwise remove unused API. Preserve and test existing simulator paths.
fixPlan.acceptance: Coordinates update in circuit units and clear when appropriate; messages reflect current operation. Auto-tick/propagation state transitions are independently exercised without duplicating stale information.

fixPlan.title: Confine hotkey UI updates to the EDT
fixPlan.reproduction: Recovered log from Preferences/New/close sequence; no new stress reproduction.
fixPlan.observed: Recorded ConcurrentModificationException; live HEAD source permits the same cross-thread mutation pattern.
fixPlan.cause: Unfiltered preference callback invokes hotkeySync over a mutable menu registry outside Swing EDT.
fixPlan.fix: Filter relevant preference keys, marshal UI updates to EDT, and manage menu/listener registration lifetime safely. Avoid a global flush/update for unrelated layout writes.
fixPlan.acceptance: Stress preferences changes while creating/closing scratch windows; no CME, stale menu callbacks or off-EDT Swing access. Closing preference windows releases listeners.

fixPlan.title: Isolate homes and make screenshots/build provenance reliable
fixPlan.reproduction: Read qa.sh launchapp and Loader.determineAutosaveName; compare userRoot redirection with user.home behavior.
fixPlan.observed: Original harness redirects preferences only, while unnamed autosaves target real user.home. Its shot canvas is hard-coded 2560x1600. This review supplied private Java home and used win for app/dialog captures.
fixPlan.cause: Incomplete harness isolation and screenshot dimension assumptions. This is not an extra production UI bug or evidence that real user data was modified in this review.
fixPlan.fix: In a scratch harness set user.home=$D/home plus private preference/config roots; validate effective JVM properties. Capture actual display/window geometry, handle heavyweight popups explicitly, keep the launch terminal alive and record jar hash/build provenance. Never clear real autosaves.
fixPlan.acceptance: Creating/closing/recovering disposable projects touches only the session tree. Nondefault-size captures include correct bounds. Session stop validates PIDs and leaves every other compositor/app untouched.

fixPlan.title: Treat optional convention/style changes as a design backlog
fixPlan.reproduction: Review the per-ID design recommendations against live/archived evidence and desired product behavior.
fixPlan.observed: Reports mix functional defects with preferences for icon style, toolbar alignment, label wording, dot placement, shortcuts and schematic fill.
fixPlan.cause: Different conventions or legacy styling are not independent bugs without an agreed behavior/quality criterion.
fixPlan.fix: Choose a coherent icon/copy/keyboard/zoom policy, prototype representative examples, and preserve project mappings and explicit schematic styling. Add scope labels, inline validation and property help where they reduce ambiguity.
fixPlan.acceptance: Accept a small dark/light, mouse/keyboard prototype at 1.0 and 1.6 before broad rollout. Record the chosen policy and require visual review; do not change data formats, electrical connectivity or saved gestures merely to match another editor.
